questions.question: Explain the difference between greater and lesser jihad.
questions.correctAnswer: Greater jihad is the internal, spiritual struggle every Muslim faces daily — resisting temptation, controlling anger, being patient, praying regularly and trying to become a better Muslim. Muhammad said after a battle: "We have returned from the lesser jihad to the greater jihad." Lesser jihad is the external struggle, which may include armed combat to defend Islam or fight injustice.
